name: Mask
meaning: Hidden sensitive values · conceal the content, retain the boundary

name: Variable
meaning: A hidden value inside a variable container.

name: Core
meaning: A private value inside a protective boundary.

name: Asterisk
meaning: The asterisk of a hidden value becomes the primary mark.

name: Sealed
meaning: An asterisk hidden in negative space.

name: keysy*
meaning: An asterisk integrated into the name.

name: Secret
meaning: A variable masked by an asterisk.

name: Scope
meaning: An asterisk represents a hidden value; brackets define its boundary. Clear and direct; code brackets are common.

name: Gate
meaning: Enclose a private value, leaving only a controlled entrance. Strong standalone silhouette; more abstract meaning.

name: Store
meaning: A masked value and a storage unit. Emphasizes centralized custody; more detail at small sizes.

name: Rotate
meaning: Two arcs surround a central secret; gaps suggest replacement and renewal. Suited to credential lifecycles; may also read as sync.
